title: Payment methods
pageHelp: Connect payment gateways, set handling fees and the display order. Gateways are plugins; their settings are generated from each gateway.

list.emptyHint: Add a gateway so users can pay their orders online.
list.deleteHint: Pending orders that use it can no longer be paid and its notify URL stops working.

form.createdHint: Paste the notify URL below into the provider (when required), then enable this payment method.
form.gatewayLocked: The gateway can't be changed after creation; add a new payment method instead.
form.name: Display name
form.iconHint: A square SVG or PNG works best.
form.urlInvalid: Enter an address starting with http(s)://
form.notifyDomainHint: Leave empty to use the site URL; scheme and host only, e.g. https://pay.example.com.
form.notifyWebhook: Paste this URL into the provider's webhook settings (HTTPS required), otherwise orders won't be activated automatically.
form.notifyAuto: The gateway sends this URL with every payment; nothing to configure.
form.feeHint: Fee = fixed amount + order amount × percentage, paid by the user.
form.enabledHint: Users can't choose a disabled payment method.

help.epay:
Enter the EPay gateway base URL (without /submit.php and without a trailing /), merchant ID and MD5 key.
“Type” may be alipay / wxpay / qqpay or a provider value (e.g. usdt.tron for GM Pay); leave it empty to let the cashier ask.
EPay is effectively CNY-only. Callbacks are sent to the notify URL automatically.
help.epusdt:
For epusdt v1 and the compatible fork BEpusdt: enter the API URL and API token (BEpusdt: System → Basic settings → API settings).
Trade type defaults to usdt.trc20; BEpusdt also supports usdc.trc20, tron.trx, usdt.polygon and more.
GM Pay v2 dropped this protocol — connect it through the EPay gateway instead.
help.alipay_f2f:
Requires an Alipay Open Platform app with Face-to-Face payment signed.
App private key: RSA2 (≥ 2048 bits), PKCS#1 or PKCS#8, PEM or bare base64.
Alipay public key: the Alipay public key, not your app public key. Only public-key mode is supported (no certificate mode). CNY only.
help.stripe:
Secret key: sk_live_… / sk_test_…, or a restricted rk_… key with Checkout Sessions write access.
In Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks add an endpoint for the notify URL below with checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, then paste its signing secret (whsec_…).
Set an exchange rate when charging in a currency other than the site currency. Alipay/WeChat Pay must be enabled in the Dashboard first.
help.coinbase:
Coinbase Business (Commerce closed on 2026-03-31; US and Singapore merchants), settles in USDC.
Create an ECDSA CDP API key and paste its name (organizations/…/apiKeys/…) and PEM secret.
Create a webhook subscription for checkout.payment.* (cdp data webhooks subscriptions create) targeting the notify URL below, and paste its secret. Exchange rate = USDC per site-currency unit.
help.btcpay:
Enter the BTCPay Server URL, Store ID (Store → Settings → General) and an API key with btcpay.store.cancreateinvoice and btcpay.store.canviewinvoices.
In Store → Settings → Webhooks add a webhook whose payload URL is the notify URL below, and paste its secret.

icons.label: Icon
icons.hint: Pick a built-in icon or use your own image. New payments start with the gateway's icon.
icons.customHint: A square SVG / PNG (https:// or a /path), or a single emoji.
icons.customInvalid: Enter an image URL starting with https:// or /, or a single emoji
